items.response:
Booking Ascari for Sat 16 Aug at 19:00, party of 5; it has the good vegetarian pastas and a kids' butter pasta for Leo. For Thanksgiving I'll look at flights to Vancouver for the three of you, leaving Fri 10 Oct and returning Mon 13 Oct.
Action: book Ascari, then search Toronto to Vancouver flights for three for Oct 10 to 13 and bring you the best options before booking anything.

So far today: I drafted your out-of-office for Fri 22 May (back Mon 25 May, Aisha covering payouts), which isn't set yet, and checked the retro: 9 yes, Olivia tentative, Jonah no reply, 14 stickies with webhook retries the top theme. I also said I'd check your calendar for anything on the 22nd.
Action: finish the calendar check for the 22nd and ask whether you want the out-of-office set.

Probably not all fine. My notes say Leo's passport expires in January and yours in March, and the Lisbon trip is 18 to 30 Dec 2026, so unless both were already renewed they won't work for it. I don't see any renewal confirmations in what I have, and I have nothing on Sam's.
Action: search your email and notes for passport renewals and expiry dates for all three of you, and report which are valid past the return date with the usual 3 to 6 months of margin.

Here's a draft she can adapt: 'Hi [name], thank you for the feedback on the facade drawings. Since the brief has changed twice since we started, redoing them falls outside the original scope and we can't take it on at no charge. We'd be glad to revise them under a change order, and can send a fee and timeline for the updated brief.'
Action: adjust the tone with you, and fill in the client's name and any scope clause from her contract before she sends it.

You're welcome. The camp check is back: drop-off is at the Winchester St gate 8:45 to 9:15, pickup 15:45 to 16:15, and the camper health form and authorized pickup list are both still outstanding in the City's camp portal (photo consent is optional). The first-day orientation email goes out the Friday before camp.
Action: add to-dos for the health form and pickup list before Mon 29 Jun, and keep looking for iron-on name labels.

Adding Grace's 68th birthday on Thu 19 Nov 2026, plus a reminder two weeks ahead, on Thu 5 Nov, to sort a gift. Noted that the Ottawa weekend falls before her real day.
Action: add the birthday and the 5 Nov gift reminder to your calendar.

I don't have the comparison in front of me, so I won't guess at the reasons. I'll look for your reno notes and the quotes and emails from the three contractors, and summarize why Nate won.
Action: search your notes and email for the reno comparison, then send Sam-ready bullets on why you picked Nate.

I'll build a one-page drill sheet around the three things you named: ser vs estar with emotions and locations, por vs para, and the future subjunctive after cuando (cuando llegue a casa, te llamo). I'll use Mexican vocabulary, end with a short role-play, and put the answer key on a separate page. Carlos's notes also flag preterite vs imperfect and gender of -ma nouns, so I'll add a few of those unless you'd rather keep it to three.
Action: write the sheet, save it to your notes, and show it to you before your lesson.

Two clean ones: 'Finance asked everyone to cut costs, so this joke is free.' or 'Month-end close is the only time 'it balances' counts as a happy ending.' Both are workplace-safe and nothing about crypto.
Action: none; say the word if you want more options, or I can save your pick to your notes.

I don't have your exact job title in front of me, and a benefits form needs the official one, so I'd rather not guess.
Action: search your email and documents for your offer letter, HR system emails or email signature to find the official title, then draft a short responsibilities line for you to confirm.

That sounds miserable. I can send facilities a short note about your floor's thermostat if you want.
Action: hold unless you say yes.

Ugh, standing the whole way with someone's backpack in your face is a rough start. Two things are waiting whenever you're ready: where the team wants the beta feedback log to live, and whether you want the 10:30 at Gears for Leo's bike on Sat 23 May.
Action: hold both until you reply.

Good night. Tomorrow's order is dry cleaner first (opens at 9), Home Depot at Gerrard Square, then the library on the way home, leaving around 10:00 so you're back well before 1. Enjoy the Biscuit blanket.
Action: nothing further tonight.

My most recent note says your waste day is Tuesday, with green bin every week, set out by 7:00 am, so bins go out Monday evening. An older note had Leslieville on Thursdays, and holiday weeks shift pickup a day, so I'd rather confirm than assume.
Action: check the City's collection calendar for your address this week and set the 20:00 reminder for the night before.

I don't have your list of trouble spots in front of me, so I'd be guessing. I'll check your Spanish notes and past drills first, then build the 8 to 10 questions.
Action: search your notes for your recurring Spanish mistakes and build the quiz; if I find nothing, I'll ask you for your top three.

It does sound like a lot, glad it's Friday. One thing to keep on the radar: the Fintech Meetup page needs your talk title and a 400x400 headshot by 18 Sep, and the bio is drafted.
Action: remind you Monday about the talk title.

Sounds good. A reminder that Nate still needs the kitchen wall choice by Monday, with a 3-week lead time, and I can gather fresh options this afternoon if you want.
Action: wait for your word on whether to start collecting wall options.

I need the electrician's arrival window before I can give the crew a time that works. Once I have it, I'll find the crew lead's contact in your notes and messages and draft the heads-up for you to approve.
Action: ask you for the electrician's Monday window, then draft the message to the kitchen crew.

Classic, sleep well.
Action: none.

Pulling them live from Linear now. My last note from 26 Aug lists PAY-1182, PAY-1190, PAY-1216, PAY-1203 and PAY-1211 as open payouts tickets, but I can't tell which carry the payouts-ga tag or their current status, so I'll use the live list.
Action: query Linear for open tickets tagged payouts-ga and return only titles and status.

Posting the retro reminder to #payouts-launch now. Table in CAD, assuming your rates are in Canadian dollars: Starter $3.20 on $100 and $29.30 on $1,000; Growth $2.85 and $26.25; Scale $2.40 and $22.20; Enterprise custom.
Action: post the Slack message to #payouts-launch and send you the formatted table.

So far this morning: I added Felipe (Paws on Pape) as a dog walker at $50 a week, which puts monthly pet spend around $729 against your $350 budget; I built the Notion page 'Payouts v2 launch risks (2025-11-12)' with six risks, two of which (PAY-360, PAY-366) need estimates by 2025-11-14; and I'm pulling October grocery spend with August and September for comparison.
Action: send the grocery comparison as soon as it's back.

For the sync, a light opener from your 'standup openers' note would work, or a one-minute icebreaker like 'one small win from this week'. For the evening at home, easy options are homemade pizza and a movie, takeout and a board game, or a slow dinner and a show you've both been meaning to start.
Action: tell me which day you mean, and I'll check the calendar for clashes and pull a joke from 'standup openers'.

You're welcome. The 7:50 reminder to move the car is set, and I'm still pulling the street-cleaning schedule for your block.
Action: send you the schedule when it's ready and offer to add reminders for the night before.

Saved: no meetings before 9:30 or after 17:00, ever. On Spanish, I don't have your lesson notes or any recent practice in front of me, so an honest grade would be a guess; give me a few lines in Spanish or a 10-minute role-play and I'll give you a straight assessment.
Action: save the calendar rule and flag any existing meetings outside 9:30 to 17:00 for you to decide on.

Sorry, dropping two calls in an afternoon is a rough way to go into a weekend. I don't have your provider or account details in front of me, so I'll find them in your billing emails first. In the meantime, rebooting the modem and using a wired connection for important calls may help.
Action: identify the provider, check for a local outage, and open a ticket saying the connection has dropped repeatedly this afternoon and needs fixing before the weekend (I'll tell you if their site needs your login).

Added 'get passport photos for Leo' to your to-do list.
Action: add it now, and tell me if you want a due date or a reminder.

Your most recent note says yard waste on your street is picked up every other Thursday, starting 9 Apr 2026, in paper bags or labelled rigid containers only, with branches under 7.5 cm, bundled, max 1.2 m and 20 kg. An older note had Tuesdays, so I'll confirm against the City calendar before I add anything, since holidays can shift a pickup.
Action: confirm the next two pickup dates on the City's calendar, check the family calendar for clashes, and add them with an evening-before reminder.

I don't have yesterday's route saved in what I can see, so I won't guess at the time.
Action: look back through our chat and your notes for the route I gave you; if I can't find it, I'll re-run the directions and give you the expected drive time.

My pick is ChessKid, which is built for kids and designed to be ad-free, with Lichess as a free, ad-free fallback if you want something less kid-styled. I'd rather verify the current ads, in-app purchase and pricing details before you download anything.
Action: check the App Store listings and privacy details for both and send you the one pick with what it costs.

Holding the charcoal bag order. I don't have the basement kitchen setup in what I can see, so I'll check your reno notes. Also noted: the plumber is coming Mon 29 Jun between 09:00 and 12:00.
Action: search your notes for what's in the basement kitchen, then suggest a realistic low-effort cooking plan for the week.

Here's the full one: 'Tres tristes tigres tragaban trigo en un trigal. En tres tristes trastos, tragaban trigo tres tristes tigres.' Good luck, Carlos should be properly impressed if you get through it clean. For Sunday night, I can write down your top three launch-week priorities and a first-hour plan for Monday so you can stop carrying it.
Action: wait for your word on the launch-week plan.

Glad Biscuit's okay. Since Aisha prefers async Slack threads over meetings, I'd put the proposal to her in a short Slack message: cut payout nicknames and the scheduled-payouts calendar view from the Mon 25th sprint, with a request for her view by Thursday.
Action: draft the Slack message for your approval and set a Thursday reminder to check her reply.

Roughly, a heat warning means the heat criteria are forecast for about two days, and an extended heat warning means the heat is expected to last about three days or more, so the risk to health is higher. I'd rather confirm the exact current criteria than quote them from memory.
Action: check the active alert for your area and tell you which one it is and when it's expected to end.
